# Using the API

Coda's REST API is designed to be straightforward to use.

The Coda API (Superhuman Docs API) API uses Bearer token authentication; has freemium pricing; offers a free tier (API available free of charge in both free and paid workspaces); rate limits: Reading data: 100 req/6s; Writing (POST/PUT/PATCH): 10 req/6s; Writing doc content: 5 req/10s; Listing docs: 4 req/6s; Reading analytics: 100 req/6s; errors return HTTP 429.
The latest released Pack version that has been verified (approved)

**mcp-coda** is a [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) server for the [Coda API](https://coda.io/developers/apis/v1) — **54 tools**, **12 resources**, and **5 prompts** covering docs, pages, tables, rows, formulas, controls, permissions, folders, publishing, automations, and analytics.
